description: Search the full Mintive documentation and get back matching pages with their ids, titles, and URLs. Use this first for any Mintive question: setup, capabilities, security, or a specific connector (Snowflake, Slack, GitHub) or feature (SCIM, SIEM export, prompt security, Coworker Agents). Then pass a result id to the fetch tool to read the page. Coverage spans architecture, enterprise controls, and per-connector setup guides.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language or keywords. Examples: "connect Snowflake", "SCIM provisioning", "block risky agent commands", "set up SSO with Okta", "Coworker Agent Slack".
